LanguageData.FCPauseTithesDesc: When enabled, no tithe items will be collected for this resource at tax time. Its production value will be converted to silver income instead. Your tithe settings are preserved and will resume when unpaused.
LanguageData.FCTitheModifierDesc: A flat silver bonus added to this resource's tithe budget on top of the value of the resource itself. It scales with the number of workers assigned to this resource.
LanguageData.FCPerWorkerDesc: The tithe modifier contributed by each assigned worker, after the tithe value multiplier. A flat daily silver amount added to the tithe budget per worker, independent of production.
LanguageData.FCTotalTitheModDesc: The combined tithe modifier from all assigned workers (the per-worker modifier times the number of workers), after the tithe value multiplier.
LanguageData.FCTotalProdDesc: The daily silver value of this resource's taxable production, after the tithe value multiplier. This is the production component of the daily tithe budget.
LanguageData.FCAutoMaxRandomTitheDesc: When enabled, the random tithe budget automatically fills the remaining projected tithe budget after your explicit tithes. Adding explicit tithes will reduce the random budget accordingly.
LanguageData.FCTitheOverBudget: If the used tithe budget is greater than the available tithe budget, then at tax time, all selected tithe options will be pruned until the used budget meets the available budget.
LanguageData.FCRandomTithesDesc:
At tax time, you will receive a random selection of items, with a total value equal to or less than the Random Tithe Budget. You can add or remove items to the list to control what is or isn't selected.
If the lowest value item in the list has a higher value than your Random Tithe Budget, or if there are no items to select from, then the budget is carried over to the next tax period.
Random tithes are considered after your explicit tithe items are paid. If your explicit tithes consume most of the projected tithe budget, the allocated Random Tithe Budget may not actually be available at tax time.
LanguageData.FCRandomTitheAccruedDesc: The amount of leftover Random Tithe Budget that has accrued. This will be added to your Random Tithe Budget to determine the total budget for Random Tithes at tax time.
LanguageData.FCDisburseAccruedRandomTitheDesc: If checked, then the Accrued Budget will be disbursed as raw silver come tax time. It will not count towards the Random Tithe Budget.

LanguageData.FCPerDayTitheBudgetDesc: The tithe budget this resource generates each day: its taxable production value plus the worker tithe modifier (after the tithe value multiplier), plus any tithe injections. Tithes are paid from the budget accrued across the whole tax period, not from a single day.
LanguageData.FCProjectedTitheBudgetDesc: The tithe budget expected to be available at tax time: everything accrued so far this period plus the per-day budget for each remaining day. Your selected tithes are paid from this projected budget.

LanguageData.FCNonIncomeResourcesDesc: These resources do not generate silver income. Their Raw Income is added to a dedicated pool instead of being converted to silver or tithes. Check the Codex for more information.
LanguageData.FCPeriodAverageTooltipHas: Income and upkeep are snapshot each day. At tax time, the silver paid out is the average of those daily snapshots.
LanguageData.FCPeriodAverageTooltipNone: No snapshots have been taken yet this tax cycle. The headline value shows the current daily rate.\n\nOnce a day has passed, the headline will switch to the period-averaged value, which is what actually gets paid at tax time.
LanguageData.FCPeriodAverageTooltipFaction: This is the sum of every settlement's expected payout, minus edict upkeep. Each settlement snapshots its income and upkeep daily, with the silver paid at tax time being the average of those snapshots.
LanguageData.FCTotalAccruedDesc: The income, in silver, this settlement has accrued from this resource since the last tax.
LanguageData.FCProjectedIncomeDesc: The total silver this resource is projected to produce by the next tax: the amount accrued so far this cycle, plus its current daily rate times the days remaining.\n\nStockpile diversions are already deducted; tithes are settled at tax time.
LanguageData.FCBuildingDormant: Dormant: inputs unmet. This building is mothballed and contributes nothing until its inputs are supplied.
LanguageData.FCProjectedTooltip: Income and upkeep accrue daily. The headline shows the projected full-cycle total: what has accrued so far this cycle plus the current daily rate times the days remaining until tax. At tax you collect the accumulated net, minus tithe goods.
LanguageData.FCProjectedTooltipFaction: The sum of every settlement's projected full-cycle payout, minus edict upkeep. Each settlement accrues income and upkeep daily; at tax it pays the accumulated net.
